packageRules.description: Wait 3 days before an npm update is proposed. A release that is yanked or compromised usually shows up in that window. Applies to root package.json and app/package.json. GitHub Actions and .nvmrc are not delayed.
Keep @playwright/test, playwright, and playwright-core in one pull request. Major updates stay in their own pull request because separateMajorMinor is on.
Keep Vite and its React plugin in one pull request. The plugin's peer range follows Vite majors, so updating either one alone cannot install.
Automerge Playwright patch and minor updates after required CI checks pass.
Bundle other non-major devDependency updates into one Monday pull request and automerge it after required CI checks pass.
Major updates always need a person to review them.
PR body: root npm updates. One note per PR: the rules below do not overlap.
prBodyNotes:
## What changed

Renovate updates the test and tooling packages listed in the table below.

## What problem it solves

Keeps the test tooling current: bug fixes, security fixes and new features.

## How to test locally

```bash
git fetch origin {{{branchName}}} && git switch {{{branchName}}}
nvm install && nvm use
npm run setup
```

```bash
npm run test:ai
npm test
```

When done: `git switch main && npm run setup`.

## Risk

{{#if isMajor}}**Medium to high.** A major version can include breaking changes: read the release notes below and check the failing CI jobs, if any.{{else}}**Low.** A minor or patch update; CI must pass before it merges.{{/if}}

Nothing to run locally: GitHub Actions only run on GitHub. Open the **Checks** tab and confirm every job is green, especially the jobs that use the updated action.
